standard-dialogue.player: You seem rather happy for a busy labourer with a bad case of spots.

standard-dialogue.npc: Of course! These spots are the best thing since log rollers!
Well thanks to these spots, the city has been under quarantine. That means there's no goods coming in or out. No goods means we don't have any work to do!
I would take a dermatological irritation over back-breaking, mind-numbing labour any day!

steps.npc: The High Priest has determined that these spots aren't contagious. He's opened the city up again, which means we have to go back to work.
Now that all the plagues have been cured, we've had to go back to work.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.player: Cheer up! Work can't be that bad.

using-a-potion-on-him.player: I have this acne potion that I thought might clear up your spots?

using-a-potion-on-him.npc: What, so that I can get back to work?

using-a-potion-on-him.player: So that you don't suffer needlessly?

using-a-potion-on-him.npc: I know your type, trying to ruin the small man's fun! I won't have it!

using-a-potion-on-him.player: Look, I'm sorry. I only wanted to help you.
